```{ojs}
labChrome = {
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
  const offset = meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "./";
  const href = new URL(offset + "labs/lab-chrome.js", document.baseURI).href;
  try {
    const chrome = await import(href);
    chrome.installLabChrome();
    return chrome;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error("The laboratory chrome did not load: " + (error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)));
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
    : { truth: "#9a3412", estimate: "#1d4e9e", bias: "#9a6b12", variance: "#1f7a4d", ise: "#9f1239", silver: "#9a6b12" };
  return { ...accent, rug: ink.muted, mise: ink.text, text: ink.text };
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof labControls = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const seq = api.sequence(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
  const drawn = api.samplePrefix(seq, api.DEFAULTS.population, api.DEFAULTS.n);
  if (drawn.error) throw new Error(drawn.error);
  const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(drawn.values);
  if (ruled.error) throw new Error(ruled.error);
  const start = ruled.value;
  const series = [
    ["bias", "Bias²"],
    ["variance", "Variance"],
    ["mise", "MISE"],
    ["ise", "ISE"],
  ];
  const form = labChrome.controlRow("Kernel density controls");
  form.innerHTML = `<label class="control-field control-field-wide">
      <span id="kde-bandwidth-label">Bandwidth h</span>
      <span class="control-slider">
        <input name="hslider" type="range" min="0.02" max="2.5" step="0.001" aria-labelledby="kde-bandwidth-label" aria-describedby="kde-control-hint">
        <input name="hnumber" type="number" min="0.005" max="20" step="0.001" aria-label="Bandwidth h as a number">
      </span>
    </label>
    <label class="control-field">
      <span id="kde-n-label">Sample size n</span>
      <span class="control-slider">
        <input name="nslider" type="range" min="2" max="${api.MAX_N}" step="1" aria-labelledby="kde-n-label" aria-describedby="kde-control-hint">
        <output name="nout"></output>
      </span>
    </label>
    <label class="control-field">
      <span id="kde-pop-label">Distribution</span>
      <select name="population" aria-labelledby="kde-pop-label"></select>
    </label>
    <label class="control-field control-field-fixed">
      <span id="kde-seed-label">Seed</span>
      <input name="seed" type="number" step="1" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" aria-labelledby="kde-seed-label">
    </label>
    <div class="control-actions">
      <button type="button" name="newer">New sample</button>
      <button type="button" name="silver">Silverman h</button>
      <button type="button" name="restore">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="control-toggles" role="group" aria-label="Panel B series"></div>
    <p class="control-hint" id="kde-control-hint"></p>
    <p class="control-note"></p>`;
  form.querySelector("#kde-control-hint").textContent =
    `n is a prefix of ${api.MAX_N} draws from this seed. Changing h does not redraw them. Arrow keys move a focused slider. Shift changes h by 0.1 and n by 10.`;
  const showPopulation = () => {
    const item = api.POPULATIONS.find((row) => row.id === form.population.value);
    form.population.title = item ? item.label + ": " + item.detail : "";
  };
  for (const item of api.POPULATIONS) {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = item.id;
    option.textContent = item.label;
    option.title = item.detail;
    form.population.appendChild(option);
  }
  for (const [key, label] of series) {
    const box = document.createElement("input");
    box.type = "checkbox";
    box.name = key;
    box.checked = true;
    const item = document.createElement("label");
    item.append(box, document.createTextNode(" " + label));
    form.querySelector(".control-toggles").appendChild(item);
  }
  const note = form.querySelector(".control-note");
  const readSeries = () => series.filter(([key]) => form[key].checked).map(([key]) => key);
  const snapshot = (bandwidth) => ({
    bandwidth,
    drawCount: Number(form.nout.value),
    populationId: form.population.value,
    seedValue: Number(form.seed.value),
    seriesOn: readSeries(),
  });
  const showBandwidth = (value) => {
    form.hslider.min = String(Math.min(0.02, value));
    form.hslider.max = String(Math.max(2.5, value));
    form.hslider.value = String(value);
    form.hnumber.value = Number(value).toFixed(4);
  };
  const showCount = (value) => {
    const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(api.MAX_N, Math.round(value)));
    form.nslider.value = String(n);
    form.nout.value = String(n);
    form.nout.textContent = String(n);
    return n;
  };
  showBandwidth(start);
  showCount(api.DEFAULTS.n);
  form.population.value = api.DEFAULTS.population;
  showPopulation();
  form.seed.value = String(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
  form.value = {
    bandwidth: start,
    drawCount: api.DEFAULTS.n,
    populationId: api.DEFAULTS.population,
    seedValue: api.DEFAULTS.seed,
    seriesOn: readSeries(),
  };
  const emit = (bandwidth) => {
    note.textContent = "";
    form.value = snapshot(bandwidth);
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  form.hslider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const value = Number(form.hslider.value);
    showBandwidth(value);
    form.value = snapshot(value);
  });
  form.hslider.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (!event.shiftKey) return;
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight" && event.key !== "ArrowUp" && event.key !== "ArrowDown") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const dir = event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 1;
    const next = Math.round((Number(form.value.bandwidth) + dir * 0.1) * 1000) / 1000;
    if (!(next > 0) || next > 20) return;
    showBandwidth(next);
    emit(next);
  });
  form.hnumber.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const value = Number(form.hnumber.value);
    if (!(value > 0) || value > 20 || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
      note.textContent = "Bandwidth must be a positive finite number no larger than 20. The previous value is still in use.";
      form.hnumber.value = Number(form.value.bandwidth).toFixed(4);
      return;
    }
    showBandwidth(value);
    emit(value);
  });
  form.nslider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    showCount(Number(form.nslider.value));
    form.value = snapshot(form.value.bandwidth);
  });
  form.nslider.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    if (!event.shiftKey) return;
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight" && event.key !== "ArrowUp" && event.key !== "ArrowDown") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const dir = event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 1;
    showCount(form.value.drawCount + dir * 10);
    emit(form.value.bandwidth);
  });
  form.population.addEventListener("change", () => {
    showPopulation();
    emit(form.value.bandwidth);
  });
  form.seed.addEventListener("change", () => {
    if (form.seed.value.trim() === "") {
      note.textContent = "The seed is empty. The sample was not redrawn.";
      form.seed.value = String(form.value.seedValue);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = Number(form.seed.value);
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed)) {
      note.textContent = "The seed must be an integer. The sample was not redrawn.";
      form.seed.value = String(form.value.seedValue);
      return;
    }
    const wrapped = parsed >>> 0;
    note.textContent = parsed === wrapped ? "" : "Stored as an unsigned 32-bit integer, so " + parsed + " uses the same sequence as " + wrapped + ".";
    form.seed.value = String(wrapped);
    form.value = { ...snapshot(form.value.bandwidth), seedValue: wrapped };
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.querySelector(".control-toggles").addEventListener("change", () => emit(form.value.bandwidth));
  form.newer.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const next = (Number(form.value.seedValue) + 1) >>> 0;
    form.seed.value = String(next);
    note.textContent = "";
    form.value = { ...snapshot(form.value.bandwidth), seedValue: next };
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  form.silver.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const sample = api.samplePrefix(api.sequence(form.value.seedValue), form.value.populationId, form.value.drawCount);
    if (sample.error) {
      note.textContent = sample.error;
      return;
    }
    const next = api.silvermanNrd0(sample.values);
    if (next.error) {
      note.textContent = next.error;
      return;
    }
    showBandwidth(next.value);
    emit(next.value);
  });
  form.restore.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const again = api.samplePrefix(api.sequence(api.DEFAULTS.seed), api.DEFAULTS.population, api.DEFAULTS.n);
    const next = api.silvermanNrd0(again.values);
    if (again.error || next.error) {
      note.textContent = (again.error || next.error);
      return;
    }
    showBandwidth(next.value);
    showCount(api.DEFAULTS.n);
    form.population.value = api.DEFAULTS.population;
    showPopulation();
    form.seed.value = String(api.DEFAULTS.seed);
    for (const [key] of series) form[key].checked = true;
    note.textContent = "";
    form.value = {
      bandwidth: next.value,
      drawCount: api.DEFAULTS.n,
      populationId: api.DEFAULTS.population,
      seedValue: api.DEFAULTS.seed,
      seriesOn: readSeries(),
    };
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
draws = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  if (!Number.isInteger(seedValue)) return { error: "The seed must be an integer. No sample was drawn." };
  const dist = api.population(populationId);
  if (dist.error) return dist;
  const seq = api.sequence(seedValue);
  if (seq.error) return seq;
  const drawn = api.samplePrefix(seq, populationId, drawCount);
  if (drawn.error) return drawn;
  return { values: drawn.values, components: dist.components, n: drawCount, population: dist, seed: seedValue >>> 0 };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
pairWork = draws.error ? draws : kdeApi.pairCache(draws.values)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
drawsSettled = {
  const snapshot = draws;
  const work = pairWork;
  await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 100);
    invalidation.then(() => clearTimeout(timer));
  });
  return { snapshot, work };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
riskCurves = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const settled = drawsSettled;
  if (settled.snapshot.error) return settled.snapshot;
  if (settled.work.error) return settled.work;
  const components = settled.snapshot.components;
  const n = settled.snapshot.n;
  const cache = settled.work;
  const grid = api.bandwidthGrid(api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, api.CURVE_COUNT);
  if (grid.error) return grid;
  const ise = api.iseCurve(cache, grid, components);
  if (ise.error) return ise;
  const mise = api.miseCurve(n, grid, components);
  if (mise.error) return mise;
  const minIse = api.minimiseRisk((band) => {
    const row = api.iseFromCache(cache, band, components);
    return row.error ? row : { value: row.value };
  }, api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, api.CURVE_COUNT, api.ISE_FINE);
  if (minIse.error) return minIse;
  const minMise = api.minimiseRisk((band) => {
    const row = api.miseParts(n, band, components);
    return row.error ? row : { value: row.mise };
  }, api.BAND_LO, api.BAND_HI, 31, api.MISE_STEP);
  if (minMise.error) return minMise;
  return {
    grid,
    ise: ise.values,
    variance: mise.integratedVariance,
    bias: mise.integratedSquaredBias,
    mise: mise.mise,
    minIse,
    minMise,
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
labReadout = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const entries = [];
  const alerts = [];
  const add = (label, value, title) => entries.push({ label, value, title });
  if (draws.error || pairWork.error) {
    alerts.push(draws.error || pairWork.error);
  } else {
    const ruled = api.silvermanNrd0(draws.values);
    const ise = api.iseFromCache(pairWork, bandwidth, draws.components);
    const risk = api.miseParts(draws.n, bandwidth, draws.components);
    const fmt = viewFns.formatNumber;
    add("n", String(draws.n));
    add("seed", String(draws.seed));
    add("h", fmt(bandwidth));
    if (ruled.error) alerts.push("Silverman (R bw.nrd0) was not computed: " + ruled.error);
    else add("bw.nrd0", fmt(ruled.value), api.SILVERMAN_RULE);
    if (ise.error) alerts.push("Integrated squared error was not computed: " + ise.error);
    else {
      add("ISE", fmt(ise.value));
      if (ise.value < 0) alerts.push("ISE is negative. The value is shown as computed and was not replaced.");
    }
    if (risk.error) alerts.push("MISE was not computed: " + risk.error);
    else {
      add("IVar", fmt(risk.integratedVariance));
      add("IBias²", fmt(risk.integratedSquaredBias));
      add("MISE", fmt(risk.mise));
      if (risk.integratedVariance < -1e-8 || risk.integratedSquaredBias < -1e-8) {
        alerts.push("A risk term is negative by more than roundoff. The value is shown as computed and was not replaced.");
      }
    }
  }
  const root = labChrome.readoutLine(entries);
  if (!draws.error && !pairWork.error) {
    root.dataset.seed = String(draws.seed);
    root.dataset.n = String(draws.n);
    root.dataset.h = String(bandwidth);
    root.dataset.population = draws.population.id;
    root.dataset.sample = draws.values.slice(0, 8).map((v) => v.toPrecision(12)).join(",");
  }
  if (alerts.length) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "graph-alert";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = alerts.join(" ");
    root.appendChild(alert);
  }
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
densityChart = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const frame = labChrome.graphFrame("Estimate");
  if (draws.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "graph-alert";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = draws.error;
    frame.section.appendChild(alert);
    return frame.section;
  }
  const [xMin, xMax] = viewFns.supportWindow(draws.values, draws.components);
  const xs = viewFns.densityGrid(xMin, xMax, draws.values);
  const truth = xs.map((x) => ({ x, y: api.mixturePdf(x, draws.components) }));
  const estimated = api.kdeOnGrid(xs, draws.values, bandwidth);
  let clipped = false;
  let estimate = null;
  if (!estimated.error) {
    const trueMax = truth.reduce((m, row) => Math.max(m, row.y), 0);
    const cap = Math.max(trueMax, 1e-6) * 4;
    estimate = xs.map((x, i) => ({ x, y: estimated.values[i] }));
    clipped = estimate.some((row) => row.y > cap);
  }
  const yTop = viewFns.topOf(truth, estimate, clipped);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.max(280, width),
    height: viewFns.chartHeight(width),
    style: viewFns.plotStyle(themeColors),
    x: { label: "x", domain: [xMin, xMax], grid: true },
    y: { label: "density", domain: [0, yTop], grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(truth, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: themeColors.truth, strokeDasharray: "7 4", strokeWidth: 2.25 }),
      estimate ? Plot.line(estimate, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: themeColors.estimate, strokeWidth: 2.5 }) : null,
      Plot.link(draws.values.map((x) => ({ x, y1: 0, y2: yTop * 0.04 })), {
        x1: "x",
        x2: "x",
        y1: "y1",
        y2: "y2",
        stroke: themeColors.rug,
        strokeOpacity: 0.5,
        strokeWidth: 1,
      }),
    ].filter(Boolean),
  });
  chart.setAttribute("role", "img");
  chart.setAttribute("aria-label", `True density and Gaussian kernel estimate for ${draws.n} observations at bandwidth ${viewFns.formatNumber(bandwidth)}.`);
  frame.plot.appendChild(chart);
  frame.section.appendChild(labChrome.markerLegend([
    { text: "True density", color: themeColors.truth, kind: "line", dash: "dashed" },
    { text: "Estimate", color: themeColors.estimate, kind: "line" },
    { text: "Sample", color: themeColors.rug, kind: "rug" },
  ]));
  if (estimated.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "graph-alert";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = "The kernel curve was not drawn: " + estimated.error;
    frame.section.appendChild(alert);
  } else if (clipped) {
    const note = document.createElement("p");
    note.className = "graph-note";
    note.textContent = "The estimate exceeds the top of the plot. The axis stops at 4 times the true density so that curve stays visible.";
    frame.section.appendChild(note);
  }
  return frame.section;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
riskChart = {
  const api = kdeApi;
  const frame = labChrome.graphFrame("Risk against bandwidth");
  if (riskCurves.error) {
    const alert = document.createElement("p");
    alert.className = "graph-alert";
    alert.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    alert.textContent = riskCurves.error;
    frame.section.appendChild(alert);
    return frame.section;
  }
  const chosen = new Set(seriesOn);
  const rows = riskCurves.grid.map((band, i) => ({
    h: band,
    bias: riskCurves.bias[i],
    variance: riskCurves.variance[i],
    mise: riskCurves.mise[i],
    ise: riskCurves.ise[i],
  }));
  let yMax = 0;
  let yMin = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const key of chosen) {
      if (row[key] > yMax) yMax = row[key];
      if (row[key] < yMin) yMin = row[key];
    }
  }
  if (!(yMax > yMin)) yMax = yMin + 1;
  const silver = draws.error ? { error: draws.error } : api.silvermanNrd0(draws.values);
  const xValues = rows.map((row) => row.h);
  if (Number.isFinite(bandwidth)) xValues.push(bandwidth);
  if (silver.value) xValues.push(silver.value);
  const xLo = Math.min(api.BAND_LO, ...xValues);
  const xHi = Math.max(api.BAND_HI, ...xValues);
  const marks = [];
  const style = {
    bias: { stroke: themeColors.bias, strokeDasharray: "2 2" },
    variance: { stroke: themeColors.variance, strokeDasharray: "7 4" },
    mise: { stroke: themeColors.mise, strokeWidth: 2.4 },
    ise: { stroke: themeColors.ise, strokeDasharray: "5 2 1 2" },
  };
  for (const key of ["bias", "variance", "mise", "ise"]) {
    if (!chosen.has(key)) continue;
    marks.push(Plot.line(rows, { x: "h", y: key, ...style[key] }));
    const at = rows.reduce((best, row) => Math.abs(row.h - bandwidth) < Math.abs(best.h - bandwidth) ? row : best, rows[0]);
    if (Number.isFinite(at[key])) marks.push(Plot.dot([{ h: bandwidth, y: at[key] }], { x: "h", y: "y", fill: style[key].stroke, r: 3.5 }));
  }
  const markers = [
    { x: riskCurves.minMise.x, text: "min MISE " + viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minMise.x), stroke: themeColors.mise },
    { x: riskCurves.minIse.x, text: "min ISE " + viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minIse.x), stroke: themeColors.ise },
  ];
  if (silver.value) markers.push({ x: silver.value, text: "bw.nrd0 " + viewFns.formatNumber(silver.value), stroke: themeColors.silver });
  markers.push({ x: bandwidth, text: "h " + viewFns.formatNumber(bandwidth), stroke: themeColors.estimate });
  for (const marker of markers) {
    marks.push(Plot.ruleX([marker.x], { stroke: marker.stroke, strokeWidth: 1.25, strokeOpacity: 0.85 }));
  }
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.max(280, width),
    height: viewFns.chartHeight(width),
    style: viewFns.plotStyle(themeColors),
    x: { label: "bandwidth h", domain: [xLo, xHi], grid: true },
    y: { label: "risk", domain: [Math.min(0, yMin), yMax * 1.08], grid: true },
    marks,
  });
  chart.setAttribute("role", "img");
  chart.setAttribute("aria-label", `Risk against bandwidth. Minimum MISE on the grid at ${viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minMise.x)}. Minimum ISE on the grid at ${viewFns.formatNumber(riskCurves.minIse.x)}.`);
  frame.plot.appendChild(chart);
  frame.section.appendChild(labChrome.markerLegend([
    { text: "Bias²", color: themeColors.bias, kind: "line", dash: "dotted" },
    { text: "Variance", color: themeColors.variance, kind: "line", dash: "dashed" },
    { text: "MISE", color: themeColors.mise, kind: "line" },
    { text: "ISE", color: themeColors.ise, kind: "line", dash: "dashed" },
  ]));
  frame.section.appendChild(labChrome.markerLegend(markers.map((marker) => ({
    text: marker.text,
    color: marker.stroke,
    kind: "tick",
  }))));
  if (!document.querySelector("[data-lab-page]")) {
    const open = document.createElement("p");
    open.className = "graph-note";
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
    const offset = meta ? meta.getAttribute("content") : "./";
    link.href = offset + "labs/kernel-density.html";
    link.textContent = "Open the laboratory page";
    open.appendChild(link);
    frame.section.appendChild(open);
  }
  return frame.section;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewFns = {
  function formatNumber(value) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "not finite";
    const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
    if (magnitude !== 0 && (magnitude < 1e-3 || magnitude >= 1000)) return value.toExponential(4);
    return value.toPrecision(4);
  }
  function chartHeight(px) {
    return Math.max(340, Math.round(Math.min(px, 980) * 0.62));
  }
  function plotStyle(colors) {
    return {
      color: colors.text,
      background: "transparent",
      fontFamily: '-apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif',
      fontSize: "12px",
    };
  }
  function supportWindow(values, components) {
    let lo = Infinity;
    let hi = -Infinity;
    for (const component of components) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, component.mean - 4 * component.sd);
      hi = Math.max(hi, component.mean + 4 * component.sd);
    }
    for (const x of values) {
      if (x < lo) lo = x;
      if (x > hi) hi = x;
    }
    return [lo - 0.45, hi + 0.45];
  }
  function densityGrid(xMin, xMax, values) {
    const xs = [];
    const steps = 280;
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) xs.push(xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps);
    for (const x of values) xs.push(x);
    xs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const out = [];
    for (const x of xs) {
      if (x < xMin || x > xMax) continue;
      if (!out.length || x - out[out.length - 1] > 1e-8) out.push(x);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function topOf(truth, estimate, clipped) {
    const trueMax = truth.reduce((m, row) => Math.max(m, row.y), 0);
    let kdeMax = 0;
    if (estimate) for (const row of estimate) if (row.y > kdeMax) kdeMax = row.y;
    const cap = Math.max(trueMax, 1e-6) * 4;
    const shown = clipped ? Math.min(kdeMax, cap) : Math.max(trueMax, kdeMax);
    return Math.max(shown, 1e-6) * 1.08;
  }
  return { formatNumber, chartHeight, plotStyle, supportWindow, densityGrid, topOf };
}
```
